name: Isolated service context development v76 r2
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - codex/hia-context-development-v76-r2-20261112-dda7
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  context-development:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Verify actual Linux Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 runner
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json, platform
          release = platform.freedesktop_os_release()
          observed = {
              "system": platform.system(),
              "architecture": platform.machine(),
              "distribution": release.get("ID"),
              "version_id": release.get("VERSION_ID"),
          }
          Path("runner-platform.json").write_text(json.dumps(observed, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n")
          print(json.dumps(observed, sort_keys=True))
          if observed != {"system": "Linux", "architecture": "x86_64", "distribution": "ubuntu", "version_id": "24.04"}:
              raise RuntimeError("context development requires actual Linux Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64")
          PY
      - name: Checkout isolated harness
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: harness
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout exact current product source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: f8d9680a9b0ae609850c006480a7d1f68ea00979
          path: source
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.14.4'
      - name: Install original Clang 20 native execution prerequisites
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl --fail --location --retry 3 --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-llvm.asc" https://apt.llvm.org/llvm-snapshot.gpg.key
          fingerprint=$(gpg --show-keys --with-colons "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-llvm.asc" | awk -F: '$1 == "fpr" { print $10; exit }')
          test "$fingerprint" = 6084F3CF814B57C1CF12EFD515CF4D18AF4F7421
          sudo install -m 0644 "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-llvm.asc" /usr/share/keyrings/hia-llvm.asc
          printf '%s\n' 'deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/hia-llvm.asc] https://apt.llvm.org/noble/ llvm-toolchain-noble-20 main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/hia-llvm20.list
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y binutils gcc clang-20 libclang-rt-20-dev strace
          printf 'CLANG=/usr/bin/clang-20\nHEPTA_CLANG=/usr/bin/clang-20\n' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Install original pinned Python prerequisites
        run: python -m pip install setuptools==78.1.1 wheel==0.46.3 z3-solver==4.15.4.0 jsonschema==4.26.0
      - name: Actual context component and complete original Agent controls
        run: >-
          python -B harness/inputs/run_context_development.py
          --source source --inputs harness/inputs --output context-development-evidence
      - name: Retain complete original evidence and exact inputs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: hia-context-v76-development-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            context-development-evidence
            harness/inputs
            runner-platform.json
          if-no-files-found: error

from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from copy import deepcopy
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import yaml

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
before={p:sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ('original-r2.yml','revised-r3.yml')}
old=yaml.load((ROOT/'original-r2.yml').read_text(),Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
new=yaml.load((ROOT/'revised-r3.yml').read_text(),Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
projected=deepcopy(new)
projected['name']=old['name']
projected['on']['push']['branches']=old['on']['push']['branches']
steps=projected['jobs']['context-development']['steps']
checkout=[s for s in steps if s.get('name')=='Checkout exact current product source']
assert len(checkout)==1
assert checkout[0]['with'].pop('fetch-depth')=='2'
assert projected==old
commands=[]
def call(label,argv,cwd,expected=0):
    started=time.monotonic_ns()
    result=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=cwd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=15,check=False)
    record={'label':label,'argv':argv,'cwd':str(cwd),'returncode':result.returncode,
            'stdout':result.stdout.decode(),'stderr':result.stderr.decode(),
            'elapsed_ns':time.monotonic_ns()-started,'timeout_seconds':15}
    commands.append(record)
    (ROOT/(label+'.stdout.log')).write_bytes(result.stdout)
    (ROOT/(label+'.stderr.log')).write_bytes(result.stderr)
    assert result.returncode==expected,record
    return result.stdout.decode().strip()
fixture=ROOT/'git-fixture'
fixture.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
origin=fixture/'origin'
call('init',['git','init','--initial-branch=main',str(origin)],ROOT)
call('name',['git','config','user.name','HIA fixture'],origin)
call('email',['git','config','user.email','hia-fixture@example.invalid'],origin)
(origin/'witness.txt').write_text('original parent\n')
call('add-parent',['git','add','witness.txt'],origin)
call('commit-parent',['git','commit','-m','fixture parent'],origin)
parent=call('parent',['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],origin)
(origin/'witness.txt').write_text('exact child\n')
call('add-child',['git','add','witness.txt'],origin)
call('commit-child',['git','commit','-m','fixture child'],origin)
head=call('head',['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],origin)
for depth in (1,2):
    target=fixture/('depth-'+str(depth))
    call('clone-'+str(depth),['git','clone','--depth='+str(depth),origin.as_uri(),str(target)],ROOT)
    assert call('head-'+str(depth),['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],target)==head
    value=call('parent-'+str(depth),['git','rev-parse','HEAD^'],target,128 if depth==1 else 0)
    if depth==2:
        assert value==parent
assert before=={p:sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in before}

        'fixture_only':True,'product_git_identity_tested':False,'native_execution_performed':False,
        'original_remote_failure_blob':'42999ce8957a519185e7231768ddccc02c8b4831'}
(ROOT/'RESULT.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
